title: Forestrie named living document frontmatter
description: The current state of an area, identified by slug and revised in place: architecture.md, area documents, runbooks, the protocol spec, product briefs (ADR-0071 sections 4-6).

id.description: The filename stem (or directory name), e.g. architecture, internal-api-versioning.

owner.description: The GitHub user or team accountable for keeping the document true, e.g. robinbryce or forestrie/platform.

review-by.description: Date by which the owner re-reads the document against the code. Tooling reports documents past this date as stale.
